Name.Text: Fresh/Recirculating Air Door Motor -V154, actual value

Messwert.Meldungstext: \T\Y\F\J\NY\Y\S\J\NZ\L\S\G\A Notes:\Y\S\K\N J\L\S\K\N \L\S\K\IOne count corresponds to 19.6 mV (measured to signal ground).\Y\S\K\N J\L\S\K\I At 5 V (5000 mV) voltage supply of the position sensor, 5000 mV = 255 counts * 19.6 mV. e.g. flap position, actual value in measuring value block is 43 counts, therefore 43 * 19.6 = 843 mV. Therefore there is a voltage of 843 mV applied at signal wire of position sensor at control module measured to signal ground (GND).\Y\S\K\N J\L\S\K\I Short circuit to Ground (GND) is permanently monitored by the control module. If the voltage value at signal wire of control module is < 100 mV or < 5 counts, the respective malfunction is stored.\Y\S\K\N J\L\S\K\I Open circuit/short circuit to B+ is permanently monitored by the control module. If the voltage value at signal wire of control module is > 4900 mV or > 250 counts, the respective malfunction is stored.
